name: Guardforce Morphmajig
subtitle: it looks angry! what's it saying?
rules: This card can attack even if it has not been in play under your control since the start of the turn. -- If you play a card, put a token on this card. (Playing a resource doesn't count.) -- If your opponent plays a card, remove a token from this card. -- This card gains 1 strength and 1 life for each token on it.
notes: Unsure, so different: the card's reminder '(Playing a resource doesn't count.)' appears only after the token-adding paragraph, not after 'If your opponent plays a card, remove a token', while the catalog adds the reminder to the opponent paragraph (so opponent resource plays could count on the card as printed). Card prints 'If you play a card' / 'If your opponent plays a card'; catalog has 'When you deploy' / 'When an opponent deploys'. Flavor is written in leetspeak (decodes to 'Excuse me fine sirs, would you mind stepping out of the bog?'); punctuation characters transcribed best-effort at this resolution (the leet 'M' reads as |V| when zoomed; could be |\/|). 'play' vs catalog 'deploy' is old vs current templating (CR: deploy = play a non-resource card). Footer has www.thespoils.com in place of an artist credit.

name: Hired Goons
subtitle: goons. hired goons.
rules: COVERT -- At the start of your turn, you may pay 2. If you don't, your opponent takes control of this card.
notes: Card prints 'your opponent'; catalog has 'an opponent'. Footer has www.thespoils.com in place of an artist credit.

name: Exploding Sock Puppet!
subtitle: taxi apple sponge!
rules: Your opponent cannot respond to this card. -- COST – Play this only in response to a character's ability. -- EFFECT – The ability has no effect. Destroy the character.
notes: Card prints 'Your opponent cannot respond to this card' as its own line, then COST 'Play this only in response to a character's ability' and EFFECT 'The ability has no effect. Destroy the character.'; catalog moves the no-response line into EXTRA COST, says 'Deploy' and 'Terminate the ability'. Footer has www.thespoils.com in place of an artist credit.

name: Discommodiousness
subtitle: limited edition artwork by FangWei
rules: Your opponent must reveal their hand and shuffle all tactics from it into their deck. Your opponent draws X cards, where X is the number of tactics shuffled into their deck. Draw a card.
notes: Artist Series printing (footer 'ARTIST SERIES' and watermark); no 'Art:' credit line, artwork credited by subtitle to FangWei (also signed in the art). Catalog words it 'An opponent reveals their hand. Shuffle all tactics revealed this way into their deck. That player draws X cards...'; same effect.
